foot_tagline: An education company from Ukraine. Learning apps for a new life.
meta_desc: Orizo Labs is an education company from Ukraine. We build the language-learning app 2000 Phrases and are developing two directions: civil safety and professional training.
og_title: Orizo Labs — a new horizon every day
og_desc: An education company from Ukraine: 2000 Phrases, civil safety and professional training.
hero_lead: Orizo Labs is an education company from Ukraine. We build learning apps that help people live confidently in a new reality: speak up in a new country, get ready for a crisis, master a new job.
products_intro: Orizo is one project with four directions: languages for life, readiness and safety, professional training, and health. Each product solves one big job and serves a shared mission.
p2000_desc: English, Polish, German and Spanish for Ukrainians abroad. Ready-made phrases for the doctor, work, paperwork and everyday life, with tips in Ukrainian.
pacad_desc: Knowledge built on Ukraine's experience that helps people, families and communities act calmly in a crisis.
path_intro: We move from the most urgent needs of a person in a new situation towards deeper preparation and work.
path1_p: 2000 Phrases: four languages, levels A1–B2, graded reading, Military English.
path2_p: Knowledge that helps you act calmly in a crisis. In development.
path3_p: A direction with PSDinfo for those who serve and those preparing to serve. In development.
path4_p: Job-specific courses: construction, care and healthcare, logistics, hospitality, IT.
path5_p: Step-by-step guides to documents, banking, doctors, renting and schools in a specific country.
story_p1: Since 2022, millions of Ukrainians have found themselves in a new country within weeks, without the language, while air-raid alerts, blackouts and shelters became part of everyday life. We saw how much simple knowledge matters: what to tell a doctor, how to stop bleeding, what to pack in a go-bag.
story_p2: Orizo Labs turns this experience into learning apps — for Ukrainians and for everyone who wants to be prepared. Our goal: everyone should have the knowledge that makes a new reality less frightening.
orgs_intro: Our products work for groups too: we give access to teams, students and communities and help you see the results.
org1_p: Language training for staff from Ukraine: phrases for work, on-site safety and daily life.
org2_p: Civil safety knowledge for classes, volunteers and residents.
org3_p: Access packages for NGOs and public programmes that support people who have moved.
org4_p: Training for veterans and a new role for them: becoming an Orizo instructor or course author.
partners_p: We are looking for employers, schools, NGOs, veterans' organisations and integration programmes to bring access to the people who need it most. We are open to conversations with investors.
t2_desc: 2000 Phrases is an iPhone app: English, Polish, German and Spanish for Ukrainians. Real-life phrases, levels A1–B2, explanations in Ukrainian.
t2_og: English, Polish, German and Spanish for Ukrainians. Real-life phrases, explanations in Ukrainian.
t2_kicker: An iPhone app by Orizo Labs
t2_lead: Start speaking in a new country from your first week. Ready-made phrases for the doctor, work, paperwork and everyday life — with audio and clear tips in Ukrainian.
inside_intro: An app for Ukrainians who have moved or are getting ready to move: the interface and explanations are in Ukrainian.
s1_alt: Home screen: today's goal, level and topics
s1_p: Introductions, the doctor, work, housing, transport, documents. Levels A1–B2; a 2-minute test shows where to start.
s2_alt: Lesson: translating a phrase with a grammar tip
s2_p: Build a phrase from blocks, type it or learn by ear. Every mistake comes with a short explanation of the rule.
s3_alt: Graded reader: a story with translation and audio
s3_p: 12 stories in each language with translation and audio. Reviews arrive just as a phrase starts to fade.

free3: The first story of every level
plus1: Every lesson in every topic and level
plus4: Monthly or yearly subscription (7 days free) or a one-time lifetime purchase
q1: Do I need to sign up?
a1: No. No account is needed; your progress is stored on your iPhone.
q2: How do I move my progress to another phone?
a2: Settings → “Backup” → “Save”: you can keep the file in Files or iCloud Drive. On the new phone, choose “Restore”.
q3: How do I cancel a subscription?
a3: iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions → 2000 Phrases. Access lasts until the end of the paid period.
q4: Will there be an Android version?
a4: Yes, we are working on it. For now the app is available for iPhone.
q5: Found a mistake in a phrase?
a5: Write to us at support@orizolabs.com or use “Write to the developer” at the bottom of the home screen — the email will already include the app version and language.
t2_foot: 2000 Phrases is a product of the education company Orizo Labs.
ta_title: Civil safety — an Orizo Labs direction
ta_desc: Civil safety is a direction of the education company Orizo Labs: knowledge built on Ukraine's experience that helps people and communities act calmly in a crisis.
ta_og: An Orizo Labs direction: knowledge built on Ukraine's experience that helps you act calmly in a crisis.
ta_lead: We turn Ukraine's experience into clear knowledge that helps people, families and communities act calmly in a crisis. The content is reviewed by practitioners. This direction is in development — write to us if you would like to join as a partner.
ta_foot: Civil safety is a direction of the education company Orizo Labs.
ts_desc: Support for the 2000 Phrases app: how to contact us, move your progress and manage your subscription.
ts_lead: A question, a mistake in a phrase or an idea for 2000 Phrases? Write to us — we reply in Ukrainian or English.
ts_p: Support email: support@orizolabs.com. The fastest way is “Write to the developer” at the bottom of the app's home screen: the email will already include the version, language and level.
ts_plus: You can cancel or change your subscription in iPhone Settings: your name → Subscriptions → 2000 Phrases. If you reinstalled the app or changed phones, tap “Restore purchases” on the Plus screen.
ts_priv: The app needs no account and collects no personal data. Details are in our privacy policy.
val_quote: Experience is the greatest value in life. We gather it and pass it on professionally.
val1_p: We teach only what life has tested: Ukraine's reality, military service, working abroad. Experience that came at a high price should protect others.
val2_p: Being a professional means answering for every word in a lesson. Our content is checked by people who have done it in practice, not just read about it.
val3_p: Knowledge that saves lives is free. We respect people's time, money and privacy, and we speak to them honestly.
psvc_desc: Training for those who serve and those preparing to serve, built on instructors' hands-on experience.
team_intro: Orizo Labs is an alliance of specialists, not just developers. Every product is made by people who know their craft from practice, including at international level.
r1_p: They turn experience into clear lessons: course structure, quizzes, scenarios, exams and certificates.
r2_p: They teach people in person and make sure every piece of advice works in a real situation.
r3_p: Years of service and work at a high international level are the foundation of our civil safety and professional training directions.
r4_p: Entrepreneurs and developers who bring knowledge to people's phones: fast, offline and in many languages.
pipe_intro: Every lesson travels from real experience to verified knowledge.
st1_p: Real situations from Ukraine, military service and life abroad
st2_p: Learning designers build lessons, quizzes and scenarios
st3_p: Instructors and veterans analyse every piece of advice
st4_p: Test users take the course and we improve it based on their feedback
st5_p: An exam confirms the knowledge; the certificate confirms the result
mission: Our mission: knowledge that protects life and health — free, in many languages, for everyone.
ph_desc: First aid, psychological resilience and health after military service: free courses built on the same Orizo principles.
path6_p: Courses in first aid, psychological resilience and recovery after military service.
pg_h: What saves lives is for everyone
pg1_p: Core knowledge on safety, first aid and what to do in a crisis will never be behind a paywall.
pg2_p: We translate knowledge into the languages of the people who need it, and the list keeps growing.
pg3_p: The key knowledge is available offline — exactly when there is no signal.
why2_h: Every direction solves a real problem
why2_intro: Choose a product or direction to see who needs it and why.
x1_problem: Millions of Ukrainians live abroad, but without the language it is hard to describe symptoms to a doctor, agree terms with an employer or deal with paperwork.
x1_g1: Ready-made phrases for the doctor, work, paperwork and daily life
x1_g2: Explanations in Ukrainian, no translator needed
x1_g3: 10 minutes a day, levels A1 to B2
x1_who: For Ukrainians in Poland, Germany, Spain and everywhere English is spoken.
x2_problem: Air-raid alerts, blackouts, floods and frost come suddenly. In a crisis there is no time to google: you need to know the decisions in advance.
x2_who: For families, schools, communities and employers.
x3_problem: Training has to be continuous, yet there are not enough experienced instructors for everyone.
x3_who: For service members, those preparing to serve, and instructors.
